title: Oven Smoky Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A smoky and cheesy Argentinian dish featuring sake-cooked beef, lacquer glaze, and a low-calorie friendly approach, perfect for a show-off dinner party.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sake, olive oil, garlic, and smoked paprika.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated beef onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
While the beef is cooking, prepare the lacquer glaze by whisking together the lacquer glaze ingredients.
After 15 minutes, brush the lacquer glaze onto the beef skewers and return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and top each with a sprinkle of shredded provolone cheese.
Return the skewers to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
